question: Which of the following pairs of cities is connected by Sher-Shah Suri Marg?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi-Amritsar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sher-Shah Suri Marg** is another name for **National Highway 1 (NH 1)** in India.
 
• It connects the capital city of **Delhi** with the city of **Amritsar** in Punjab.
 
• The highway is named after the great emperor Sher Shah Suri, who initially laid the foundation of this road during his reign.
 
• It is a crucial route that facilitates the movement of goods and people between the northern states of India.
 
• The highway also passes through key cities like **Panipat, Karnal, Kurukshetra, Ambala, and Ludhiana**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sher Shah Suri**:

 
 
• He was the founder of the Suri Empire in North India, and he reigned from 1540 to 1545.
 
• He is known for his administrative reforms and the introduction of the currency system known as "Rupiya."
 
• He revamped and extended the ancient Grand Trunk Road, which is now part of modern NH 1.
 
 
 
• **National Highways in India**:
 
 
• National highways are the primary roadways that connect major cities and regions across India.
 
• They are managed by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI).
 
• These highways play a crucial role in the economic development by enhancing connectivity and transportation.
 
 
 
• **Grand Trunk Road**:
 
 
• The Grand Trunk Road is one of Asia's oldest and longest major roads.
 
• It stretches from Chittagong in Bangladesh to Kabul in Afghanistan.
 
• This historic road has been a key trade route for centuries.
 
 
 
• **Modernization of NH 1**:
 
 
• NH 1 has undergone significant upgrades to meet modern transportation needs.
 
• It includes the construction of flyovers, bypasses, and the widening of roads to accommodate increasing traffic.
 
• The modernization ensures safer and faster travel between major cities.
